name: Caltech-UCSD Birds-200-2011 (CUB-200-2011)
description: Fine-grained bird image dataset containing 11,788 images across 200 bird species, with image-level class labels and additional annotations.
citation: Wah, C., Branson, S., Welinder, P., Perona, P., & Belongie, S. (2011). The Caltech-UCSD Birds-200-2011 Dataset. California Institute of Technology. CNS-TR-2011-001.
